name: sdlc
description: AI-native SDLC loop based on Anthropic's AI-Native SDLC Playbook. /sdlc shows which stage each feature is at and runs the next one: intent, spec, RFC, plan, build, test, ship, ADR, maintain. Every stage commits a version-controlled artifact under docs/sdlc/<slug>/. EGM Goldfish reviews check the documents, and pr-review checks the code.
